evidence_items.explanation: GPT-4's release satisfies the forecast's antecedent. Its distribution within ChatGPT also makes comparisons based only on the two names difficult to interpret.
This Google Trends analysis documents substantial attention to ChatGPT before GPT-4's release. It does not measure GPT-4 or establish which launch attracted more attention.
